blocker: Verified BLS series cover only exact title matches. Raw PPI and non-direct CPI prints are references, not BEA-adjusted PCE rates. Ambiguous PPI aggregates and non-exact names stay unresolved. A core PCE headline is not available from this registry alone.
match_rule: Case-insensitive exact title match after whitespace normalization. No fuzzy name derivation. CPI series ids are monthly U.S. city average rows from the CU series master (periodicity R). PPI series ids are PC industry-product master rows. Semiannual CUUS series are ignored.
